# Dragoon's Town v0.23

This update improves town activity and begins a targeted longevity rebalance. Existing saves, earned prestige bonuses and permanent holdings remain compatible.

- People and pets follow the painted walking surfaces in both town orientations and all five districts. Return routes stay on separate pavement patches rather than crossing roofs or trees.
- Increase people by 150% and dogs by 300%, with a bounded activity pool. Low/Off activity, reduced motion and battery saver remain available.
- Open prestige at $1 trillion eligible run earnings, with +10% at $1T, +20% at $4T and +30% at $16T. Keep earned bonuses, reset confirmation and the credited-hour requirement between resets.
- Improve the first two businesses' opening income, with the lift fading by 25 locations. Add useful production from business investments above 1,000 locations. Business prices, milestone thresholds and the ordinary middle production curve are preserved.
- Carry extra purchased locations into the next contract. Claim all shows the cash/supply reward and completes eligible batches without deleting progress. Contract cash does not count toward prestige earnings.

Twelve 90-day strategy/schedule simulations, threshold-only controls, financial/save tests and browser/mobile checks support this first pass. Middle-game pacing, the large higher-tier transition above 1,000 and retained-income prestige incentives remain further balancing work; no fixed completion time is promised.

No real payments, advertisements, account service or paid servers were added. Android code 12 retains the original package and signing identity. Update through More → App updates → Check now without uninstalling.

Physical Thor/Android 13 installation and sustained performance remain separate playtests. Automated checks and compilation are not physical-device results.

AI-assisted development with OpenAI Codex.
